_readme: Footage slots for the Short and the companion. Put official Tesla clips in source/public/footage/ and set `file` (name inside that folder), `in` (seconds into that file), and optionally `cx`/`cy` (0..1 crop centre for the 9:16 fill), `zoom` (>=1) and `audio` (0..1 level for the demo's own sound). A slot with file=null renders as a labelled placeholder and blocks the final render (tools/check_footage.py). Record every clip in footage/CLIP_LEDGER.md.

F1_AIRBORNE.label: Roadster midair on its jets (side angle)
F1_AIRBORNE.want: Opens the Short (128.25–130.65) and closes it: the last 3.4 s play 124.85–128.25 so the end loops into frame 0.

F2_RAMP_CLIMB.label: Climbing the curved ramp (first run, wide)

F3_INVERTED.label: Upside down against the ramp (close-up from below)
F3_INVERTED.want: 77.5–78.9, and 78.9–79.55 as the match-cut into the suction diagram; the close-up shot runs 77.47–79.90

F4_LAUNCH_ROLL.label: Leaves the ramp and rolls on its jets (aerial angle)
F4_LAUNCH_ROLL.want: 137.95–140.85; the aerial landing at +6.5 s (144.45–146.23) is the 'So yes, the demo flew' shot

F6_FIVE_VEHICLES.label: Flipping over a Semi and a row of Teslas (side angle)
F6_FIVE_VEHICLES.want: 18.6–22.83: front angle of the approach with the Semi and the row (to 20.97), then the side angle of the flip over the Semi. Five vehicles are not clearly countable, so the Short uses the 'row of Teslas' line

F7_ACCEL_RUN.label: 0-60 run with Tesla's on-screen timer
F7_ACCEL_RUN.want: 15.6-21.84 side angle: launch, timer runs 0.00 -> 1.00 (17.15-18.1), thruster smoke; +6.0 s = top-down angle (21.6-25.4) for the opening tease

F8_OPTIMUS_SEAT.label: Optimus in the driver's seat
F8_OPTIMUS_SEAT.want: Companion only: door opens, Optimus seated (Engadget: only for show).
